scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc --build --force && pnpm run build:rollup
scripts.build:ordered: pnpm run build:types && pnpm run build:utils && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:adapter && pnpm run build:leaflet-adapter
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run version:patch && pnpm run build && pnpm -r publish --access=public
scripts.release:minor: pnpm run version:minor && pnpm run build && pnpm -r publish --access=public
scripts.release:major: pnpm run version:major && pnpm run build && pnpm -r publish --access=public
